command: set -euo pipefail; expected=950076ace1d41b10dfdd7a20e494e03e976a5339; actual=$(git rev-parse HEAD); echo HEAD=$actual; test "$actual" = "$expected"; port=/dev/cu.usbserial-1130; test -e "$port"; source scripts/source_idf.sh >/tmp/growbox-eink-flash-idf.log 2>&1; chip=$(esptool.py --port "$port" chip_id 2>&1); printf '%s\n' "$chip"; grep -q 'ESP32-S3' <<<"$chip"; build=$(mktemp -d)/stage27c; export STAGE27C_BUILD_DIR="$build"; export PORT="$port"; export GROWBOX_EINK_DISPLAY_ENABLED=1; export GROWBOX_RF433_LOOPBACK_ENABLED=0; export GROWBOX_STAGE28_REAL_OUTPUTS_ENABLED=0; export GROWBOX_STAGE28_THERMAL_TEST_SEQUENCE_ENABLED=0; bash scripts/stage27c_crowpanel.sh flash; generated=$(find "$build" -path '*/generated/climate/runtime/RuntimeBuildConfig.h' -print -quit); test -n "$generated"; grep -q 'kEinkDisplayEnabled = 1 != 0' "$generated"; grep -q 'kEinkSclkGpio = 12' "$generated"; grep -q 'kEinkMosiGpio = 11' "$generated"; grep -q 'kEinkCsGpio = 45' "$generated"; grep -q 'kEinkDcGpio = 46' "$generated"; grep -q 'kEinkRstGpio = 47' "$generated"; grep -q 'kEinkBusyGpio = 48' "$generated"; grep -q 'kEinkPowerGpio = 7' "$generated"; grep -q 'kRf433LoopbackEnabled = 0 != 0' "$generated"; grep -q 'kRealOutputsEnabled = 0 != 0' "$generated"; grep -q 'kThermalTestSequenceEnabled = 0 != 0' "$generated"; test -f "$build/growbox_ml_controller.bin"; git diff --check; test -z "$(git status --short)"
